famLabel.stock: stock tools (kubectl; Prometheus, Loki, Jaeger in the cluster)
famLabel.obs_only: stock telemetry MCP only (Prometheus, Loki, Jaeger tools; no kubectl)

failureModes.gave up: tools failing: No cause named and the submission says so, after at least half of the tool calls returned errors.
failureModes.gave up: no cause named: No faulty component named; the submission says the evidence was insufficient or the cause could not be established.
failureModes.wrong component: A healthy component was blamed as the origin (judge D1-Q1 No and D1-Q3 No).
failureModes.no component named: The diagnosis names no faulty component (D1-Q1 No) without declaring itself inconclusive.
failureModes.symptom, not origin: The right area, but a secondary failure was presented as the cause (D1-Q2 No).
failureModes.wrong mechanism: Right component, wrong explanation of how it fails (D2-Q1 No).
failureModes.wrong fault type: Right component and roughly right mechanism, but attributed to the wrong kind of fault (D2-Q3 No).
failureModes.right cause, imprecise: Localisation and mechanism accepted; details, scope or symptoms were missing or over-attributed (D2-Q2 or D3 No), and the composite fell below 0.70.
failureModes.below threshold: Every checklist item was answered Yes or left blank, yet the composite score is below 0.70.
